definitions.meaning: The term of the Lease is eighty-six (86) months, subject to earlier termination and possible extension for the remainder of a calendar month if the Commencement Date is not the first day of a calendar month.
definitions.sourceText: The term of the Lease shall be for eighty-six (86) months (or until sooner terminated as herein provided) (the "Lease Term")...

definitions.meaning: The earlier of substantial completion of the Premises in accordance with Landlord's plans and specifications (but not earlier than February 1, 2007) or the date Tenant takes possession of any portion of the Premises, subject to acceleration for Tenant Delay.
definitions.sourceText: The Commencement Date shall be the earlier of (i) the date upon which the Premises have been substantially completed... but which shall not be deemed to have occurred earlier than February 1, 2007... or (ii) the date on which Tenant takes possession of a portion of or all of the Premises...

definitions.meaning: The date five (5) months following the Commencement Date.
definitions.sourceText: Beginning five (5) months following the Commencement Date (the “Rental Start Date”)...

definitions.meaning: Calendar year 2007 for comparison of Direct Operating Expenses.
definitions.sourceText: ...exceeds the Direct Operating Expenses for the base year 2007 (hereinafter called the “Base Year”).

definitions.meaning: For each calendar year or portion thereof, the amount by which Direct Operating Expenses exceed the Base Year's Direct Operating Expenses.
definitions.sourceText: As used herein, the "Operating Expense Amount" shall mean, for each calendar year (or portion thereof), the amount by which the Direct Operating Expenses (defined below) exceeds the Base Year's Direct Operating Expenses.

definitions.term: Tenant's Proportionate Share of Direct Operating Expenses
definitions.meaning: The Operating Expense Amount multiplied by a fraction with numerator 46,978 rentable square feet and denominator 410,571 rentable square feet.
definitions.sourceText: "Tenant's Proportionate Share of Direct Operating Expenses" shall mean, for each calendar year (or portion thereof), the product of (i) the Operating Expense Amount... multiplied by (ii) a fraction, the numerator of which is the number of square feet contained in the Premises (46,978) and the denominator of which is the number of rentable square feet contained in the Building (410,571).

definitions.meaning: All operating costs for the Building and the Building's share of operating costs for parking areas, common areas, and the Property, subject to stated inclusions and exclusions.
definitions.sourceText: For purposes of this Lease, the term "Direct Operating Expenses" shall consist of all "operating costs" ... for the Building, and the Building’s share of all operating costs for any parking area and common area serving the Building, and the Property...

definitions.meaning: Petroleum or chemical liquids or solids, liquid or gaseous products, contaminants, oils, radioactive materials, asbestos, PCB's, urea-formaldehyde, toxic or hazardous waste or hazardous substances under specified federal, state, and local laws.
definitions.sourceText: As used herein, "Hazardous Materials" means any petroleum or chemical liquids or solids, liquid or gaseous products, contaminants, oils, radioactive materials, asbestos, PCB's, urea-formaldehyde, or any toxic or hazardous waste or hazardous substances...

definitions.meaning: Four percentage points higher than the prime commercial lending rate from time to time of SunTrust Bank in Atlanta, Georgia, capped at the maximum lawful rate.
definitions.sourceText: ...with interest at the rate of four percentage points higher than the prime commercial lending rate from time to time of SunTrust Bank in Atlanta, Georgia, provided, however, that if such rate exceeds the maximum rate permitted by law, the maximum lawful rate shall apply; the interest rate so determined is hereinafter called the "Agreed Interest Rate".

definitions.meaning: An assignment or subletting to an Affiliate, including an entity controlling, controlled by, or under common control with Tenant, or an entity with which Tenant merges or consolidates.
definitions.sourceText: ...any assignment or subletting to any firm, person, corporation, partnership or other entity (an “Affiliate”), now or hereafter directly or indirectly in control of, controlled by or under common control with Tenant... or which or with which Tenant shall merge or consolidate (collectively, an “Affiliate Transfer”)...

clauses.title: 1. Term and Possession
clauses.sourceText: The term of the Lease shall be for eighty-six (86) months (or until sooner terminated as herein provided) (the "Lease Term"), beginning on (i) February 1, 2007 or (ii) the "Commencement Date" (as hereinafter defined), whichever shall last occur, except that if the Commencement Date is other than the first day of a calendar month, the term hereof shall be extended for the remainder of that calendar month.

effect.action: occupy the Premises for the Lease Term

clauses.title: 2(a). Monthly Rental Payment Obligation
clauses.sourceText: Beginning five (5) months following the Commencement Date (the “Rental Start Date”), Tenant shall pay to Landlord throughout the term of this Lease rental as set forth below, payable in equal monthly rental installments and payable in advance on the first day of each month during every year of the term hereby demised...

effect.action: pay monthly rent in equal monthly installments in advance on the first day of each month

clauses.title: 2(a). Base Rent Period 1
clauses.sourceText: Rental Start Date - 03/31/08 ... Monthly Rent $75,360.54

clauses.title: 2(a). Base Rent Period 7
clauses.sourceText: 04/01/13 - Last Day of Lease Term ... Monthly Rent $91,333.06

clauses.title: 2(b). Late Charge
clauses.sourceText: If rent or any other payment due hereunder from Tenant to Landlord remains unpaid five (5) days after said amount is due, the amount of such unpaid rent or other payment shall be increased by a late charge to be paid to Landlord by Tenant in an amount equal to five percent (5%) of the amount of the delinquent rent or other payment.

clauses.title: 2(c). Operating Expense Pass-Through
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall pay to Landlord as additional rent Tenant's proportionate share of the amount by which the Direct Operating Expenses incurred by Landlord in the operation of the Building during each calendar year of the Lease Term exceeds the Direct Operating Expenses for the base year 2007... "Tenant's Proportionate Share of Direct Operating Expenses" shall mean... the Operating Expense Amount multiplied by... 46,978 / 410,571.

clauses.title: 2(c). Operating Expense Estimates and Reconciliation
clauses.sourceText: On or about December 31 of each calendar year during the Lease Term, Landlord shall estimate the amount of Direct Operating Expenses... Within One Hundred Eighty (180) days after December 31 of any calendar year... Landlord shall advise Tenant in writing, of the amount of actual Direct Operating Expenses... Tenant shall pay such deficiency... within thirty (30) days following its receipt of such invoice.

clauses.title: 3. Security Deposit
clauses.sourceText: Tenant hereby deposits with Landlord on the date hereof the sum of Seventy Seven Thousand Eight Hundred Twenty Six and 89/100 Dollars ($77,826.89)... as security for the full, timely and faithful performance of Tenant's covenants and obligations under this Lease.

clauses.title: 4. Occupancy and Use
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall use and occupy the Premises for general office purposes and for no other use or purpose without the prior written consent of Landlord.

clauses.title: 5(a). Compliance with Laws
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall not use the Premises or permit anything to be done in or about the Premises which will in any way conflict with any law... and Tenant shall at its sole cost and expense promptly comply with all laws... relating to or affecting the condition, use, or occupancy of the Premises.

clauses.title: 5(b). Hazardous Materials Indemnity
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall not use, handle, store, deal in, discharge, or fabricate any Hazardous Materials... Tenant shall indemnify Landlord... from and against any and all claims, damages, losses, costs, and expenses... as a result of the existence of any Hazardous Materials on or about the Premises... caused by or related to the delivery, deposit or creation of Hazardous Materials on or about the Premises during the term of this Lease.

effect.scope: claims, damages, losses, costs, and expenses arising from hazardous materials on or about the Premises caused by or related to Tenant during the Lease Term
carveOuts: typical office supplies maintained in compliance with applicable laws and ordinances

clauses.title: 6. Alterations
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall not make or suffer to be made any alterations, additions, or improvements in, on, or to the Premises or any part thereof without the prior written consent of Landlord...

clauses.title: 7. Repair
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall, at all times during the term hereof at Tenant's sole cost and expense, keep the Premises and every part thereof in good order, condition and repair...

clauses.title: 8. Liens
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall keep the Premises free from any liens arising out of any work performed, material furnished, or obligations incurred by Tenant...

clauses.title: 9. Assignment and Subletting
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall not sell, assign, encumber or otherwise transfer... this Lease... sublet the Premises... without the prior written consent of Landlord... Landlord shall be entitled to fifty percent (50%) of all rents, fees and other considerations paid by such subtenant, assignee or occupant...

clauses.title: 10(a). Tenant Waiver of Claims Against Landlord
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall not be liable to Tenant and Tenant hereby waives all claims against Landlord for any injury or damages to any person or property in or about the Premises... except to the extent arising from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of Landlord.

clauses.title: 10(b). Tenant Indemnification of Landlord
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall hold Landlord harmless from and defend and indemnify Landlord against any and all claims or liability for any injury or damage to any person or property whatsoever... and will further indemnify, defend and save Landlord harmless against and from any and all claims arising from any breach or default on the part of Tenant...

effect.scope: claims or liability for injury, property damage, Tenant's work or transactions concerning the Premises, breach or default by Tenant, and acts or negligence of Tenant and its agents, contractors, servants, employees, invitees, and licensees

clauses.title: 10(c). Tenant Insurance Requirement
clauses.sourceText: Tenant agrees to purchase at its own expense and to keep in force during the term of this Lease all insurance coverages reasonably required by Landlord... including... Exhibit “G”.

clauses.title: 10(d). Landlord Indemnification of Tenant
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall hold Tenant harmless from and defend and indemnify Tenant against any and all claims or liabilities... to the extent such injury or damage shall be caused by the grossly negligent acts or omissions of Landlord...

clauses.title: 10(e). Landlord Property Insurance
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall maintain in force, at its sole cost and expense... "All Risk" property insurance, covering the Building, for not less than its full replacement cost.

clauses.title: 11. Waiver of Subrogation
clauses.sourceText: Each of Landlord and Tenant hereby releases the other from any and all liability or responsibility... for any loss or damage to property caused by fire or any other perils insured in policies of insurance...

clauses.title: 12. Service and Utilities
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall maintain the public and common areas of the Building... Landlord agrees to furnish to the Premises during ordinary business hours... heat and air-conditioning... janitorial services... elevator service... electricity for general office purposes and water for lavatory and drinking purposes...

clauses.title: 13. Estoppel Certificate
clauses.sourceText: Within seven (7) days following the Commencement Date or any written request which Landlord may make from time to time, Tenant shall execute and deliver to Landlord a certificate substantially in the form attached hereto as Exhibit "C"...

clauses.title: 14. Holding Over
clauses.sourceText: If Tenant retains possession of the Premises... after such termination... the daily rental shall... be equal to 150% of the rental being paid monthly to Landlord under this Lease immediately prior to such termination...

clauses.title: 15. Subordination
clauses.sourceText: This Lease shall be subject and subordinate at all times to: (a) all ground leases or underlying leases... and (b) the lien or interest of any mortgage or deed to secure debt...

clauses.title: 16. Re-Entry by Landlord
clauses.sourceText: Landlord reserves... the right to re-enter the Premises to inspect the same, to supply janitor service... to show said Premises to prospective purchasers, mortgagees or tenants...

clauses.title: 17. Insolvency or Bankruptcy
clauses.sourceText: The appointment of a receiver... or an assignment of Tenant for the benefit of creditors, or any action taken or suffered by Tenant under any insolvency, bankruptcy, or reorganization act, shall at Landlord's option constitute a breach of this Lease by Tenant. Upon the happening of any such event... this Lease shall terminate five (5) days after written notice of termination from Landlord to Tenant.

consequences: lease may terminate five days after Landlord's written notice
Tenant's lease rights are not assignable in bankruptcy or insolvency proceedings

clauses.title: 18. Default and Remedies
clauses.sourceText: The following events shall be deemed to be events of default by Tenant under this Lease... failure to pay... failure to comply with any term... hazardous condition... failure to vacate... lien execution... unauthorized assignment... Upon the occurrence of any such events of default... Landlord shall have the option to pursue... terminate this Lease or Tenant's right to possession... repossess the Premises... recover accrued rent and liquidated damages... relet the Premises...

consequences: Landlord may terminate the Lease or Tenant's right to possession
Landlord may re-enter and repossess the Premises
Tenant remains liable for accrued rent, additional rent, damages, and reletting costs
Landlord may recover liquidated damages for the balance of the term

clauses.title: 19. Damage by Fire, Etc.
clauses.sourceText: If the Building, improvements, or Premises are rendered partially or wholly untenantable by fire or other casualty... Landlord or Tenant may... terminate this Lease... If this Lease is not terminated... Landlord shall proceed with all due diligence to repair and restore...

clauses.title: 20. Condemnation
clauses.sourceText: If any substantial part of the Premises should be taken for any public or quasi-public use... and the taking would prevent or materially interfere with the use of the Premises... this Lease shall terminate...

clauses.title: 21. Sale by Landlord
clauses.sourceText: In the event of a sale or conveyance by Landlord of the Building, the same shall operate to release Landlord from any future liability... and in such event Tenant agrees to look solely to the responsibility of the successor in interest of Landlord...

clauses.title: 22. Right of Landlord to Perform
clauses.sourceText: If Tenant shall fail to perform any acts, covenants or agreements... and such failure shall continue for fifteen (15) days after written notice thereof by Landlord, Landlord may... make any such payment or perform any such act... All sums so paid... together with interest... shall be payable as additional rent to Landlord on demand...

clauses.title: 23. Surrender of Premises
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall, at least one hundred eighty (180) days before the last day of the term hereof, give to Landlord a written notice of intention to surrender the Premises... At the end of the Lease Term, Tenant agrees to peaceably deliver up to the Landlord possession of the Premises...

clauses.title: 24. Waiver
clauses.sourceText: If either Landlord or Tenant waives the performance of any term, covenant or condition contained in this Lease, such waiver shall not be deemed to be a waiver of any subsequent breach...

clauses.title: 25. Notices
clauses.sourceText: Whenever any notice, demand or request is required or permitted hereunder, such notice, demand or request shall be hand-delivered in person, by reputable courier service or sent by United States Mail, registered, postage prepaid...

clauses.title: 26. Certain Rights Reserved to the Landlord
clauses.sourceText: Landlord reserves and may exercise the following rights without affecting Tenant's obligations hereunder... to change the name of the Building... retain pass keys... close the Building after regular work hours... take measures for safety, protection, preservation or security...

clauses.title: 27. Abandonment
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall not vacate or abandon the Premises at any time during the term, and if Tenant shall abandon, vacate, or surrender said Premises... any personal property belonging to Tenant and left on the Premises shall, at the option of Landlord, be deemed to be abandoned...

clauses.title: 28. Successors and Assigns
clauses.sourceText: Subject to the provisions of Paragraph 9 hereof, the terms, covenants, and conditions contained herein shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the heirs, successors, executors, administrators and assigns of the parties hereto.

clauses.title: 29. Attorneys' Fees
clauses.sourceText: In the event that any action or proceeding is brought to enforce any term, covenant or condition of this Lease on the part of Landlord or Tenant, the prevailing party in such litigation shall be entitled to reasonable attorneys' fees...

clauses.title: 30. Corporate Authority
clauses.sourceText: If Tenant signs as a corporation, each of the persons executing this Lease on behalf of Tenant does hereby covenant and warrant that Tenant is a duly authorized and existing corporation...

clauses.title: 31. Mortgage Approvals
clauses.sourceText: Any provisions of this Lease requiring the approval or consent of Landlord shall not be deemed to have been unreasonably withheld if any mortgagee... shall refuse or withhold its approval or consent thereto.

clauses.title: 32. Miscellaneous
clauses.sourceText: Time is of the essence of this Lease and all of its provisions. This Lease shall in all respects be governed by the laws of the State of Georgia... This Lease may not be modified except by a written instrument...

clauses.title: 33. Landlord's Lien
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall have and Tenant hereby grants to Landlord a continuing security interest for all rentals and other sums of money becoming due hereunder from Tenant, upon all goods, wares, equipment, fixtures, furniture, inventory, accounts, contract rights, chattel paper and other personal property of Tenant situated on the Premises...

clauses.title: 34. Quiet Enjoyment
clauses.sourceText: Landlord represents and warrants that it has full right and authority to enter into this Lease and that Tenant, while paying the rental and performing its other covenants and agreements herein set forth, shall peaceably and quietly have, hold and enjoy the Premises for the term hereof...

clauses.title: 35. Landlord's Liability
clauses.sourceText: In no event shall Landlord's liability for any breach of this Lease exceed the amount of rental then remaining unpaid for the then current term... any liability of Landlord hereunder shall be enforceable only out of the interest of Landlord in the Building and the Property...

clauses.title: 36. Right to Relocate
clauses.sourceText: [Intentionally omitted]

clauses.title: 37. No Estate
clauses.sourceText: This contract shall create the relationship of Landlord and Tenant, and no estate shall pass out of Landlord. Tenant has only a usufruct...

clauses.title: 38. Lease Effective Date
clauses.sourceText: Submission of this instrument for examination or signature by Tenant does not constitute a reservation of or option for lease, and it is not effective as a lease or otherwise until execution and delivery by both Landlord and Tenant.

clauses.title: 39. Rules and Regulations
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall faithfully observe and comply with the rules and regulations printed on or annexed to this Lease as Exhibit "A"... and all reasonable modifications thereof and additions thereto from time to time put into effect by Landlord.

clauses.title: 40. Special Stipulations
clauses.sourceText: Special Stipulations to this Lease are set forth on Exhibit "E" attached hereto and made a part hereof. In the event of any conflict between any provision set forth in Exhibit "E" and any provision contained elsewhere in this Lease, the former in all events shall supersede, prevail and control.

clauses.title: 41. Guaranty
clauses.sourceText: [Intentionally omitted]

clauses.title: 42. Condition
clauses.sourceText: [Intentionally omitted]

clauses.title: 43. Brokerage Commissions
clauses.sourceText: Tenant shall indemnify and hold harmless Landlord and Landlord's agents from and against any and all claims for commissions or other compensation, and any liabilities, damages and costs relating thereto, that may be asserted by any person or entity other than Broker to the extent that Tenant has engaged such person or such claim results from any action of Tenant.

effect.scope: claims for commissions or other compensation by any broker or agent other than the named Broker to the extent arising from Tenant's engagement or actions
carveOuts: claims involving Colliers Spectrum Habif and Childress Klein Properties, Inc.

clauses.title: 44. Exculpation
clauses.sourceText: Tenant hereby waives any rights to bring a cause of action against the individuals executing this Lease on behalf of Landlord... and all persons dealing with Landlord must look solely to Landlord's assets for the enforcement of any claim against Landlord...

clauses.title: Exhibit A - Rules and Regulations
clauses.sourceText: Exhibit "A" sets forth building rules and regulations governing access, signage, cleaning, security, utilities, equipment, trash disposal, solicitation, safety procedures, tenant conduct, and smoking.

clauses.title: Exhibit B, Section 1 - Materials Furnished by Landlord
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall furnish and install within the Premises substantially in accordance with plans and specifications approved by Tenant and Landlord... partitions, doors, lighting fixtures... and other improvements required by Tenant...

clauses.title: Exhibit B, Section 2 - Improvement Costs to be Paid by Landlord
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall provide to Tenant a “Tenant Allowance”... not to exceed Thirty and No/100 Dollars ($30.00) per rentable square foot... The total Tenant Allowance... shall not exceed... $1,409,340.00. In addition... Landlord shall reimburse Tenant for up to $5,000.00 in costs incurred by Tenant in installing supplemental HVAC...

clauses.title: Exhibit B, Section 3 - Improvement Costs to be Paid by Tenant
clauses.sourceText: The cost of any improvements in addition to those provided by Landlord... shall be paid by Tenant, one half (1/2) upon commencement of the construction and one half (1/2) upon completion of the construction.

clauses.title: Exhibit B, Section 4 - Approval of Plans and Cost
clauses.sourceText: Landlord and Tenant shall diligently pursue the preparation of all plans and specifications for the improvements... Plans and specifications and a cost estimate... shall be approved... no later than October 26, 2006...

clauses.title: Exhibit C - Tenant Lease Estoppel Certificate
clauses.sourceText: Exhibit "C" is the form of tenant estoppel certificate, including certifications regarding lease commencement, rent, security deposit, absence of defaults, and lease status.

clauses.title: Exhibit E, Section 1 - Security Deposit and First Month's Rent
clauses.sourceText: The Security Deposit in the amount of... $77,826.89 and the First Month's Rent in the amount of... $75,360.54 are due and payable upon Lease execution by Tenant.

clauses.title: Exhibit E, Section 2 - Renewal
clauses.sourceText: Provided Tenant is not in default and as long as Tenant is still in occupancy of the Premises, Tenant shall have one (1) option to renew this Lease for the entire Premises for an additional sixty (60) month term with one hundred eighty (180) days prior written notice to Landlord of its intent to renew.

effect.action: give written notice to exercise one renewal option for an additional 60-month term

clauses.title: Exhibit E, Section 3 - Right of First Refusal
clauses.sourceText: Provided Tenant is not in default... Tenant shall have a right of refusal... Upon receipt of written notice... Tenant shall respond to Landlord within ten (10) business days whether Tenant intends to lease all of such space...

clauses.title: Exhibit E, Section 4 - Termination Option
clauses.sourceText: Provided Tenant is not in default, Tenant may terminate this Lease at the end of the sixtieth (60th) full calendar month of the term, upon giving six (6) months' prior written notice to Landlord and paying to Landlord a termination fee...

clauses.title: Exhibit E, Section 5 - Parking
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall provide to Tenant... on a nonexclusive, first come-first serve basis, 3.5 parking spaces... per one thousand (1,000) square feet of usable area leased and occupied by Tenant...

clauses.title: Exhibit E, Section 6 - Signage
clauses.sourceText: So long as American Safety Insurance Services, Inc. occupies all of the Premises, Tenant shall have the right to install its name on the exterior monument sign for the Building...

clauses.title: Exhibit E, Section 7 - Club Memberships
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall cause to be waived the initiation fees for (a) up to twenty-five (25) new memberships to the Galleria Athletic Club... and (b) up to five (5) new memberships in The Georgian Club...

clauses.title: Exhibit E, Section 8 - Contingency
clauses.sourceText: This Lease and all rights and duties of the parties hereunder are expressly conditioned upon the sale, on or before October 19, 2006, by the current owner to an unrelated third party, of that certain office building... If such sale does not occur... this Lease shall be of no force and effect.

clauses.title: Exhibit E, Section 9 - Staffing
clauses.sourceText: Landlord agrees that the Building shall be staffed with not less than three (3) day porter employees... Landlord shall provide full-time security officers and security vehicles... 24 hour a day, 7 days a week...

clauses.title: Exhibit E, Section 11 - Building Amenities
clauses.sourceText: Landlord shall at all times throughout the term of this Lease use commercially reasonable efforts to provide the following amenities within the Building: (i) Sandwich shop; (ii) Newsstand; (iii) Building conference room with audio visual capabilities; and (iv) ATM.

clauses.title: Exhibit E, Section 12 - Confidentiality
clauses.sourceText: Tenant covenants and agrees... to treat the terms of this Lease and all offers and related information delivered by Landlord to Tenant... as confidential...

clauses.title: Exhibit G - Insurance
clauses.sourceText: Exhibit "G" specifies required tenant insurance coverages, limits, additional insured requirements, carrier standards, and notice of cancellation requirements.
